photos.c: BACKPIECE: DEREK BOOSEY triple jumps 50'1½" for England in the International v. Finland at the White City. Although 4th, Derek was only 7½" behind the winner K.Rahkamo.

PHOTO (Ed. Lacey): Derek Boosey, after a season of injury, triple jumps for Great Britain in the match against Sweden at White City on Sept 14th. Derek was second with a Club record leap of 51'-8¼" [?]--only 3¼" [?] behind winner Alsop.
